title: Stackification commutes with 2-fibre products of fibred categories

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the statement

standard_prerequisites.name: Universal property of stackification
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends the canonical map from the fibre product to the fibre product of the stackifications, giving h : W -> X' x_{Y'} Z'.

standard_prerequisites.name: Stack criterion for a morphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces equivalence of h to isomorphisms of Mor sheaves plus local essential surjectivity.

standard_prerequisites.name: Essential surjectivity criterion
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the local-essential-image condition paired with the Mor-sheaf isomorphisms.

standard_prerequisites.name: Construction of the stackification
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies Mor sheaves of W locally with sheafified fibre products of Mor presheaves.

core_obligations: Build h : W -> X' x_{Y'} Z' from the canonical map into the stacky fibre product via the universal property of stackification.

Mor sheaves: work locally so xi, xi' come from (x, z, alpha), (x', z', alpha'); then Mor_W is the sheafification of the fibre product of Mor presheaves, while Mor of the target is the fibre product of the Mor sheaves; conclude by exactness of sheafification.

Essential surjectivity: any object (x', z', alpha) of the stacky fibre product locally comes from X, Z and, after replacements, alpha comes from a morphism of Y; hence it is locally in the essential image of the map from the fibred fibre product, a fortiori of h.
proof_roadmap: Construct h by the universal property, then verify equivalence through the two lemmas: Mor-sheaf isomorphisms via exactness of sheafification and local essential surjectivity via local representability of descent data.
difficulty_reason: Combines the universal property, a local reduction of Mor sheaves to sheafified fibre products, and a two-stage local essential-surjectivity argument; each stage has real content.
